sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil, never reaching the final call
sketches.resonance: The message you tried to send dissolves into nothing the moment the person you meant to reach is gone.

sketches.mechanism: A goroutine sent into a channel with no receiver blocks forever, and if main exits, it is silently killed
sketches.resonance: A voice that waits forever to be heard, then vanishes when the world moves on without noticing.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type represents a function that cannot ever return — the type system encodes impossibility as a guarantee
sketches.resonance: Some promises are kept precisely because they can never be fulfilled: the function that swears it will never leave simply never returns.
